summary: A live-play benchmark: an AI plays Oxygen Not Included one move per turn through a program inside the game, and a milestone counts only when that program reads it from game state.

shown.data: made-up sample data written by a script; no game played, no model run

built: Approved plan with a milestone ladder and scoring rules
Program that runs inside the game (bridge mod), written; compile against the installed game pending
Turn driver and its tests, passing against a stand-in game
Run viewer, reading the same run-pack format real runs will write

phases.phase: P1 Bridge test: 20 unattended turns, checkpoint saved and reloaded
P2 Harness and first level, scripted reference run

limits: No run in the real game has been recorded.
No milestone has passed and no AI model has played.
Milestone pass rules are planned and still to be checked against the game's data files.
